en: A black-and-white image depicting a European street scene with mid-20th-century cars parked in front of old buildings. There are pedestrians on the street. Prominent signage on one building reads 'ÉTTEREM' (Hungarian for 'restaurant'). There is a large advertisement with a child's face near the center, and a distinctive clock tower in the background. The architecture is classical European, with slightly worn facades.
